title: It's all about balance
text: It's all about balance. Sometimes it is a bit tricky to find the right spot so they balance appropriately. Once you find it however they do an adequate job of keep soap from creating a slimy mess.

product_metadata.title: 4 Pack - Evelots Soap Dish/Holder-Waterfall-Soap Saver/Dryer-Drain-No Mushy Soap
features: Makes Soap Last: This set of 4 cleverly designed soap dishes allows the soap to dry by draining excess water into the sink, shower, or tub. Extends soap life by keeping bars from getting soft and mushy.
Keeps Counter Clean: The soap dish spout directs water and soap suds into the sink to avoid watery messes on sink tops. No more flat dishes filled with soapy gunk.
Sleek and Modern: Contemporary design fits with any decor. Set of two soap savers made from durable, thick plastic. Two posts prevent soap from sliding into the sink or onto the counter.

Perfect Anywhere: The soap holder is perfect for the sink, shower, or countertop. Measures approximately 5.4 Inches Long by 3 Inches Wide by 2.5 Inches in Height. Spout extends over the sink. Dishwasher safe
From our Vermont home to yours: For over 10 years, Evelots has offered customers unique products with a 30-day easy return policy.
